passages.text: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribes of Israel at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said to them, “The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities in which to live, together with pasturelands for our livestock.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Levites had family leaders.
These family leaders went to Eleazar.
Eleazar was the priest.
They also went to Joshua.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
They also went to the leaders of the other tribes of Israel.
They met at Shiloh.
Shiloh was in the land of Canaan.
The Levite leaders spoke to them.
They said, “The LORD gave a command through Moses.
The LORD told Moses to give us cities to live in.
The LORD also told Moses to give us pasturelands for our livestock.”
passages.original: וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן וְאֶל־ רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם בְּשִׁלֹ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֙עַן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת־ לָ֥נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֖ן לִבְהֶמְתֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: So by the command of the LORD, the Israelites gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave a command.
The Israelites obeyed the LORD.
The Israelites gave cities to the Levites.
The Israelites also gave pasturelands to the Levites.
The Israelites gave these from their own inheritance.
The first lot was for the Kohathite clans.
Aaron was a priest.
Some Levites were descendants of Aaron.
These descendants of Aaron received thirteen cities by lot.
They received these cities from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִנַּחֲלָתָ֖ם אֶל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י וַיְהִ֡י לִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

passages.text: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
Kohath was one of the families among the Levites.
Some descendants of Kohath had already received cities.
Other descendants of Kohath still needed cities.
These remaining descendants of Kohath received cities.
The Israelites gave these cities by casting lots.
The tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh provided these cities.
The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities in total.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה־ אֶ֠פְרַיִם וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־ דָ֞ן וּמֵחֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ס

passages.text: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Gershon were Levites.
The Israelites gave cities to the Levites.
The Israelites gave these cities by the command of the LORD.
The descendants of Gershon received cities by lot.
They received thirteen cities.
They received these cities from the tribe of Issachar.
They received these cities from the tribe of Asher.
They received these cities from the tribe of Naphtali.
They received these cities from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה־ יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּמִמַּטֵּֽה־ אָ֠שֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠מֵחֲצִי מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַבָּשָׁן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

passages.text: And the descendants of Merari received twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Merari belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The descendants of Merari had their own clans.
The Israelites gave cities to the descendants of Merari.
The Israelites gave these cities by lot.
The descendants of Merari received twelve cities.
The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun gave these twelve cities.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּמִמַּטֵּה־ גָד֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

passages.text: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these cities, together with their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites gave cities to the Levites.
They also gave the Levites the pasturelands around these cities.
The LORD had commanded this through Moses.
The Israelites gave these cities and pasturelands by lot.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּגּוֹרָֽל׃פ

passages.text: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon, they designated these cities by name to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them: They gave them Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pasturelands, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the father of Anak.)
passages.sermon:
The tribes of Judah and Simeon gave certain cities by name.
They gave these cities to the descendants of Aaron.
The descendants of Aaron belonged to the Kohathite clans.
The Kohathite clans were part of the tribe of Levi.
The first lot fell to the descendants of Aaron.
They received Kiriath-arba.
Kiriath-arba is also called Hebron.
Arba was the father of Anak.
Kiriath-arba is in the hill country of Judah.
They also received the pasturelands around Kiriath-arba.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ מִמַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשֵֽׁם׃ וַֽיְהִי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַקְּהָתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה׃ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־ קִרְיַת֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אֲבִ֧י הָֽעֲנ֛וֹק הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: But they had given the fields and villages around the city to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
The Israelites gave Caleb the fields around the city.
They also gave him the villages around the city.
These fields and villages became Caleb’s possession.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־ חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָֽתְנ֛וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֖ה בַּאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave these cities, together with their pasturelands: Hebron, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Holon, Debir, Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh—nine cities from these two tribes, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Aaron were priests.
People gave cities to the descendants of Aaron.
These cities came from the tribes of Judah and Simeon.
They gave Hebron to the descendants of Aaron.
Hebron was a city of refuge for someone who killed another person.
They gave the pasturelands around Hebron to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Libnah and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Jattir and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Eshtemoa and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Holon and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Debir and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Ain and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Juttah and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
They gave Beth-shemesh and its pasturelands to the descendants of Aaron.
In total, they gave nine cities from these two tribes.
They also gave the pasturelands with these cities.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י׀ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת־ עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־ חֶבְר֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־ לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ וְאֶת־ יַתִּר֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ וְאֶת־ חֹלֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ דְּבִ֖ר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ וְאֶת־ עַ֣יִן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֗הָ וְאֶת־ יֻטָּה֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֣ים תֵּ֔שַׁע מֵאֵ֕ת שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׁבָטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃פ

passages.text: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba, Anathoth, and Almon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin gave four cities.
They gave these cities to the Levites.
The four cities were Gibeon, Geba, Anathoth, and Almon.
Each city included its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֶת־ גִּבְע֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ עֲנָתוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ עַלְמ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

passages.text: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
passages.sermon:
The priests were descendants of Aaron.
People gave them cities.
They received thirteen cities.
Each city included its pasturelands.
passages.original: כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עָרִ֖ים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: The remaining Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted these cities: From the tribe of Ephraim they were given Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Gezer, Kibzaim, and Beth-horon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathite clans were Levites.
Some Kohathite clans remained.
These remaining Kohathite clans received cities.
They received cities from the tribe of Ephraim.
They received Shechem.
Shechem was in the hill country of Ephraim.
Shechem was a city of refuge for the manslayer.
They received Gezer.
They received Kibzaim.
They received Beth-horon.
They received the pasturelands of these cities.
They received four cities in total.
passages.original: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ קְהָת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִבְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גֽוֹרָלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־ עִ֨יר מִקְלַ֧ט הָרֹצֵ֛חַ אֶת־ שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ וְאֶת־ קִבְצַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

passages.text: From the tribe of Dan they were given Elteke, Gibbethon, Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Levites received cities from the tribe of Dan.
The Levites are a group set apart to serve God.
The tribe of Dan is one of the tribes of Israel.
The Levites received Elteke and its pasturelands.
They received Gibbethon and its pasturelands.
They received Aijalon and its pasturelands.
They received Gath-rimmon and its pasturelands.
The Levites received four cities in total from the tribe of Dan.
Each city included its surrounding pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּ֨טֵּה־ דָ֔ן אֶֽת־ אֶלְתְּקֵ֖א וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶֽת־ גִּבְּת֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ גַּת־ רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

passages.text: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Taanach and Gath-rimmon—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Levite clans of the Kohathites received cities.
They received cities from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
They received Taanach and its pasturelands.
They received Gath-rimmon and its pasturelands.
They received two cities in total.
passages.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־ תַּעְנַךְ֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ גַּת־ רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: In all, ten cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathite clans were Levites.
Some Kohathite families did not receive cities earlier.
These remaining Kohathite families received ten cities.
They also received the pasturelands around these cities.
passages.original: כָּל־ עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן לְמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: From the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonites were a clan of Levites.
The Gershonites received cities.
They received these cities from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
They received Golan in Bashan.
Golan was a city of refuge for the manslayer.
They also received Beeshterah.
Each city came with its pasturelands.
The Gershonites received two cities in total.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁוֹן֮ מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַלְוִיִּם֒ מֵחֲצִ֞י מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת־ עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־ גָּלוֹן בַּבָּשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶֽת־ בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kishion, Daberath, Jarmuth, and En-gannim—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonite Levites received cities from the tribe of Issachar.
They received Kishion and its pasturelands.
They received Daberath and its pasturelands.
They received Jarmuth and its pasturelands.
They received En-gannim and its pasturelands.
They received four cities in total, with their pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־ קִשְׁי֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ דָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ יַרְמוּת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ עֵ֥ין גַּנִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

passages.text: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mishal, Abdon, Helkath, and Rehob—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonite Levites received cities from the tribe of Asher.
They received Mishal and its pasturelands.
They received Abdon and its pasturelands.
They received Helkath and its pasturelands.
They received Rehob and its pasturelands.
They received four cities in total, with their pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־ מִשְׁאָ֖ל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ חֶלְקָת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

passages.text: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Hammoth-dor, and Kartan—three cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Naphtali gave three cities.
The first city was Kedesh in Galilee.
Kedesh was a city of refuge for the person who killed someone by accident.
The second city was Hammoth-dor.
The third city was Kartan.
Each city came with its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י אֶת־ עִ֣יר׀ מִקְלַ֣ט הָֽרֹצֵ֗חַ אֶת־ קֶ֨דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִ֤יל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֙הָ֙ וְאֶת־ חַמֹּ֥ת דֹּאר֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ קַרְתָּ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שָׁלֹֽשׁ׃

passages.text: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the Gershonite clans.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonites were a clan of Levites.
The Gershonite clans received cities.
They received thirteen cities in total.
They also received the pasturelands of these cities.
passages.original: כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Merarite clan (the rest of the Levites) were given: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Jokneam, Kartah, Dimnah, and Nahalal—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Merarite clan belonged to the Levites.
They were the remaining Levite families.
They received cities from the tribe of Zebulun.
They received Jokneam and its pasturelands.
They received Kartah and its pasturelands.
They received Dimnah and its pasturelands.
They received Nahalal and its pasturelands.
They received four cities in total.
Each city included its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ מְרָרִי֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מֵאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶֽת־ יָקְנְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־ קַרְתָּ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ דִּמְנָה֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶֽת־ נַהֲלָ֖ל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

passages.text: From the tribe of Reuben they were given Bezer, Jahaz, Kedemoth, and Mephaath—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Merarite clan belonged to the Levites.
The Merarite clan received cities from the tribe of Reuben.
They received Bezer and its pasturelands.
They received Jahaz and its pasturelands.
They received Kedemoth and its pasturelands.
They received Mephaath and its pasturelands.
The Merarite clan received four cities in total from the tribe of Reuben.
Each city included its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־ בֶּ֖צֶר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־ יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־ מֵיפָ֖עַת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

passages.text: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer—four cities in all, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Merarite clan were Levites.
They received cities from the tribe of Gad.
They received Ramoth in Gilead.
Ramoth in Gilead was a city of refuge for the manslayer.
They received Mahanaim.
They received Heshbon.
They received Jazer.
Each city came with its pasturelands.
They received four cities in all.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּה־ גָ֗ד אֶת־ עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־ רָמֹ֥ת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶֽת־ מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃ אֶת־ חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־ יַעְזֵ֖ר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ כָּל־ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

passages.text: In all, twelve cities were allotted to the clans of Merari, the remaining Levite clans.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Merari clans belonged to the Levites.
Some Levite clans remained after others received their cities.
The Merari clans received cities by lot.
They received twelve cities in total.
passages.original: כָּל־ הֶ֨עָרִ֜ים לִבְנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיְהִי֙ גּוֹרָלָ֔ם עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

passages.text: For the Levites, then, there were forty-eight cities in all, together with their pasturelands, within the territory of the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Levites received cities to live in.
These cities were inside the land of the Israelites.
The Levites received forty-eight cities in total.
Each city had its own pasturelands.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ל עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָרִ֛ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Each of these cities had its own surrounding pasturelands; this was true for all the cities.
passages.sermon: Each city had its own pasturelands around it.\r\nThis was true for every city.
passages.original: תִּֽהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עִ֣יר עִ֔יר וּמִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֖ן לְכָל־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס

passages.text: Thus the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and they took possession of it and settled in it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD promised to give land to the fathers of Israel.
The LORD gave all this land to Israel.
Israel took possession of the land.
Israel settled in the land.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָתֵ֣ת לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּרָשׁ֖וּהָ וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD gave them rest on every side, just as He had sworn to their fathers. None of their enemies could stand against them, for the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave Israel rest on every side.
The LORD had promised this rest to their fathers.
No enemy could stand against Israel.
The LORD delivered all their enemies into Israel’s hand.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨נַח יְהוָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ עָ֨מַד אִ֤ישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִכָּל־ אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled.
passages.sermon:
The LORD made good promises to the house of Israel.
The LORD did not let any of His good promises fail.
The LORD fulfilled every promise He spoke to Israel.
Everything the LORD promised came to pass.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ נָפַ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּל֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַכֹּ֖ל בָּֽא׃פ
